title: Golden hour exterior: 3-bedroom house with garden, Kibagabaga
prompt:
A vertical 9:16 product reveal ad for a real-estate listing in Rwanda. Setting: the place in Image 1, exactly as in the photo (Image 2 shows more of it). Light: warm golden-hour light. Music: warm, hopeful strings.
0-3s: Low-angle shot, slow tilt up: from the gate up to the whole of the place in Image 1.
3-5s: Wide shot, slow orbit around the subject: around the front of the house, windows glowing.
5-8s: Clean hero shot, subject centred, crane up and over: rising to show the house and the green hills behind. A warm voice-over says in English: "3-bedroom house with garden, at E2E Business Test."
No on-screen text or added logos.

storyboard.notice: Preview: Seedance arrives with the BytePlus key. This is the shot plan Seedance will film; no credits were taken.
